schema:
CREATE TABLE aoc_list_queue (
                list_url TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                portal_type TEXT,
                year INTEGER,
                page_num INTEGER,
                status TEXT,
                scraped_at TEXT,
                partition_id INTEGER
            )

CREATE TABLE aoc_tenders (
                internal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                portal_type TEXT,
                year INTEGER,
                sl_no TEXT,
                aoc_date TEXT,
                closing_date TEXT,
                title TEXT,
                ref_no TEXT,
                tender_id TEXT,
                org_name TEXT,
                detail_url TEXT,
                partition_id INTEGER
            )

CREATE TABLE aoc_details (
                internal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                tender_id TEXT,
                details_json TEXT,
                scraped_at TEXT
            )

CREATE TABLE "tender_details" (
  "internal_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "tender_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "details_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "scraped_at" TEXT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("internal_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "tenders" (
  "internal_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "tender_id" TEXT NULL,
  "detail_url" TEXT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NULL,
  "organisation_name" TEXT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NULL,
  "reference_number" TEXT NULL,
  "portal_type" TEXT NULL,
  "serial_number" TEXT NULL,
  "e_published_date" TEXT NULL,
  "bid_submission_closing_date" TEXT NULL,
  "tender_opening_date" TEXT NULL,
  "corrigendum_url" TEXT NULL,
  "scraped_at" TEXT NULL,
  "partition_id" INTEGER NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("internal_id")
)
